resources.string: iOS 27 is mainly for the Galaxy S24 Ultra

iOS 27 (OneiOS) is mainly tested and working on the Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G (SM-S928B). On this phone it may be unstable, miss pieces, or not come back to One UI; Samsung devices are the ones it is written for.
